text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Spring is in the air... The spring
G1 season,
that is.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's take this chance to score an easy
victory
and build up some momentum.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. If this was enough to spook me,
I'd be a
lost cause for the rest of the
season.
choice_data_list_en: You're pretty relaxed for a G1.
You seem pretty relaxed for a G1.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter who I'm up against. All
I need to
do is be first across the finish
line.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Time to win in style! I'll show them all
what I'm
made of!
